Two ship. “?” opens the canvas cheat sheet — six groups: Selection, Navigation, Positioning, Editing, View, Context Menu (KeyboardCheatSheet.tsx:27-101). ⌘/ opens the app shortcuts panel — three groups: Panels, Edit, View (KeyboardShortcutsPanel.tsx:26-68). Each answers half of “what are the shortcuts”. One screen, grouped by surface, on both chords. (UX-F-05)

The bare letters fire while a modal is open. useSidebarKeyboard.ts:16-53 guards inputs, contenteditable and modifiers and nothing else; every other global handler calls isModalOpen() first (useEditorShortcuts.ts:85, CanvasFooterToolbar.tsx:226). Add the guard. (UX-F-31)
⌘R is the browser’s reload and the shell takes it for Rulers (CanvasFooterToolbar.tsx:271). Move the overlay chords off keys the browser owns. (UX-F-32)
